title: 生涯スポーツ演習(柔道)
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports (judo)
courseType:
Student and Study Skills Courses Program
Character Building Courses
Lifelong Sports
educationalGoal: By studying the fundamental skills of judo, students will learn the following: 1. The enjoyment of sports throughout their lifetime. 2. The knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily and through their own initiative based on the Plan-Do-Check-Action (PDCA) cycle. 3. Necessities for social/student life such as the observation of rules, respect and kindness for others, a competitive spirit, leadership/cooperation, a sense of responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice: This class aims to achieve the above-mentioned learning objectives through judo: 1. Basic knowledge of judo 2. Basic judo skills 3. Applied skills (practical practice) 4. Interaction with the community • The first round will be held at the judo hall during the fourth period on Wednesdays in all faculties. • From the second to the seventh, we will participate in a judo exchange meeting (Wednesdays: 19:30–21: 00) and interact with locals. 5. Students are required to prepare their own judo attire.
requiredKnowledge: Understanding the mental attitude and safety precautions needed in sports activities.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying an active sports lifestyle throughout your lifetime.
Be able to learn the fundamental skills needed for judo and use them in class activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain your own situation and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports activities and implement this understanding in learning activi

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Accurately express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one’s own lifetime. (2) Learn fundamental skills for judo and utilize them in class activities. (3) Accurately evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the Plan-Do-Check-Action (PDCA) cycle. (4) Understand the necessities for social life and implement them in learning activities. (5) Accurately express one’s own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and implement this understanding appropriately.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Roughly express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one’s own lifetime. (2) Learn fundamental skills for judo and utilize them roughly in class activities. (3) Roughly evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4) Understand the necessities for social life and roughly implement them in learning activities. (5) Roughly express one’s own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and roughly implement this understanding in learning activities.
